issue.title: Resolve baseline Symvision unused-public failures
issue.description: Running just check while splitting the Artifacts Beads action module exposed seven unrelated Symvision unused-public failures: BulkUnreadToggleResult in ace/tui/actions/agents/_unread_state.py; PreparedPromptArchive, clean_prompt_archive_worktree, and commit_prompt_archive_if_dirty in agents_sync/prompt_archive/publish.py; find_pending_task_triage in bead/task_gate.py; prune_prompt_artifact_pool in core/prompt_artifact_staging.py; and resolve_task_launch_cwd in bead/task_launch.py. Determine whether each symbol should be made private, deleted, or given a real production consumer, then restore a clean just _lint-symvision run.
